material_note: cho_scarp_03: grey cut-stone panels scored with tech lines: flagstone. cho_scarp_01_r: pale blue light strips: lamplight.
why_this_one: A stone pylon hung into the void, 175 of them, its blue strips pulsing. Batch 1 of the Relics, the most-placed and biggest shapes first (the user, 2026-10-23: "we need to finish first kanturu all objects before continue to make monsters"; the light: "Draft as is"). docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 8.1.
additive_from: MU's TextureScript does not brighten a lowercase _r (the _R test is case-sensitive, docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md B), but Render_Kanturu2nd_ObjectMesh type 2 draws mesh 1 alone as its own BlendMesh (RenderMesh(1, RENDER_TEXTURE, Alpha, 1, fLumi), GM_Kanturu_2nd.cpp:533-549), so the strips are added.
glow_from: MU: fLumi = (sin(WorldTime * 0.002) + 1) * 0.5 (GM_Kanturu_2nd.cpp:535, 545), a pulse between 0 and 1 every 3.1 s. Ours, marked, as the Ruins' Object47: our glow wanders over MU's range, re-aimed every half period and eased over it.
